title: Legal Assistant
lead: Ask a question about Croatian law. Every answer is backed by citations to primary sources — statutes and court decisions — that you can inspect.
disclaimer: Answers are automated and intended as informational support only. They do not constitute legal advice. Always verify each claim against the cited sources or consult a licensed lawyer.
placeholder: e.g. When does the statute of limitations begin to run for a damages claim?
